title: Verdictan Policy Configuration
description: Declarative YAML/JSON schema for Verdictan gateway policy configurations. A configuration document defines a policy configuration bundle with an enforcement chain, per-policy settings, provider targets with routing/fallback strategies, optional quality assertions, inline flagged review actions, rate limits, routes, consumer groups, caching, and more. Can also be a standalone single-policy document for prompt-injection, agent-firewall, citation-verifier, or quality-scorer.

SemVer.description: Semantic version string (major.minor.patch) with optional pre-release and build metadata suffixes.

SecretKeyReference.description: Reference to a provider or policy secret. Use env-backed refs for local configs and store-backed refs for managed provider targets.

env.description: Environment variable name that contains the secret value.

store.description: Managed config-variable name that contains the secret value.

scope.description: Optional config-variable resolution scope. Only valid with store-backed refs.

SecretKeyReference.markdownDescription:
**Environment reference**

Load the secret from an environment variable. Prefer a Verdictan-specific name for local YAML authoring so the gateway credential cannot be confused with an application credential.

```yaml
env: VERDICTAN_OPENAI_API_KEY
```

**Managed config-variable reference**

Resolve the secret from a managed config-variable store. Add scope only when you need non-default resolution.

```yaml
store: OPENAI_API_KEY
scope: org
```

PolicyKind.description: Identifier for a policy enforcement module. Used in the chain array and as keys in the policy block to configure individual policies.
markdownEnumDescriptions:
**Data Routing Policy**

Registered gateway policy kind `data-routing-policy`.

**Entity List Filter**

Registered gateway policy kind `entity-list-filter`.

**EU AI Act (reporting-only)**

Reporting-only control `eu-ai-act`. Configure under `policy.eu-ai-act` for `POST /verdictan/compliance/report`; do not place in `policies.chain` (rejected with `policy.reporting_only`).

**HIPAA PHI Detector**

Registered gateway policy kind `hipaa-phi-detector`.

ProxySelector.description: Selects gateways by name. A single string, array of strings, or an object with a regex pattern.

PolicyTargeting.description: Controls which organizational scope and gateway instances a policy applies to. When scope is 'team', the teams array must be provided.

scope.description: Enforcement scope: 'organization' applies to all teams, 'team' requires the teams array.

teams.description: Team slugs this policy applies to. Required when scope is 'team'.

gateways.description: Gateway instances this policy targets. A string, array, or regex object.

ChainEntry.description: A single step in the policy enforcement chain. Either a plain policy name string (e.g. 'prompt-injection') or a conditional object where the key is the policy name and the value specifies when/stage/parallel/targeting options.

ConfigDocument.description: Top-level configuration document containing a policy configuration bundle, enforcement chain, per-policy settings, provider targets, and optional sections for testing, routes, caching, rate limits, and more.
