RewriteRule.description: A single text transformation rule applied during request or response rewriting. Uses regex pattern matching with capture group back-references.

name.description: Human-readable name for this rule (used in logs and audit trails).

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match in the text. Supports capture groups referenced in replacement via $1, $2, etc.

replacement.description: Replacement text. Supports capture group back-references ($1, $2, etc.) when position is 'replace'.

position.description: How to apply: 'replace' substitutes matched text, 'prepend' inserts at the beginning, 'append' inserts at the end.

condition.description: Optional substring guard. The rule only fires when the text contains this substring.

RequestRewriter.description: Rewrites outbound request content before it reaches the upstream LLM provider. Can inject system messages and apply regex-based text transformations.

system_message.description: System message to prepend to the conversation. Can be a plain string or an object with 'content'. Injected as a system role message before user content.

rules.description: Ordered list of regex-based rewrite rules applied to request content. Each rule specifies a pattern and replacement.

ResponseRewriter.description: Rewrites inbound response content before it is returned to the client. Applies regex-based text transformations with optional structure preservation.

preserve_structure.description: When true, preserves the JSON structure of the response and only applies rules to text content fields. When false, rules are applied to the entire serialized body.

rules.description: Ordered list of regex-based rewrite rules applied to response content. Each rule specifies a pattern and replacement.

PromptInjection.description: Detects and blocks prompt injection attacks using pattern matching, encoding normalization, boundary enforcement, and optional embedding-based similarity detection.

embedding_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold (0–1) for embedding-based injection detection. Inputs whose embedding is this close to known attack vectors are flagged.

backend.description: Embedding backend: 'local' uses built-in heuristics and pattern matching, 'external' sends inputs to a remote embedding service.

endpoint.description: External embedding backend URL. Required when backend is 'external'.

model.description: Embedding model identifier for the external backend.

api_key.description: API key for the external embedding backend. WARNING: Prefer using environment variables and referencing them via secret_key_ref on provider targets instead of embedding raw secrets in configuration files.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for external embedding requests.

attack_patterns.description: Regex patterns that indicate prompt injection attempts. Applied after encoding normalization. Custom patterns are appended to the built-in set.

encoding.description: Encoding normalization settings. Decodes Base64, Unicode escapes, and hex sequences before pattern matching.

boundaries.description: System-user boundary enforcement. Detects attempts to override system instructions from user messages.

response.description: Response behavior when an injection is detected (block message, HTTP status code, log action).

data_poisoning.description: Data poisoning detection sub-config. Extends prompt-injection with backdoor trigger detection and perplexity anomaly analysis.

enabled.description: Enable data-poisoning detection alongside prompt injection.

backdoor_trigger_patterns.description: Custom trigger substrings to scan for in addition to built-in patterns.

perplexity_threshold.description: Perplexity score above which text is flagged as anomalous. Lower values are stricter.

anomaly_action.description: Action when poisoning indicators are detected.

PiiDetector.description: Detects and redacts personally identifiable information (PII) including credit card numbers (PCI mode), health data (healthcare mode), and custom regex patterns.

action.description: Action when PII is detected: 'redact' masks the PII in-place using the configured redaction format, 'block' rejects the entire request.

healthcare_mode.description: Enable expanded detection for healthcare-specific identifiers (MRN, insurance IDs, provider NPIs) alongside standard PII.

pci_mode.description: Enable PCI-DSS compliant detection of credit card numbers, CVVs, and cardholder data.

detect_patterns.description: Additional custom regex patterns to detect. Each pattern is treated as a PII category alongside the built-in detectors.

redaction.description: Configures how detected PII is redacted (label format, length preservation, custom markers).

PiiRedaction.description: Controls how detected PII is masked in the output text.

marker_format.description: Replacement format: 'label' → [PII_TYPE], 'asterisk' → '***', 'partial' → preserves first/last characters (e.g. J***n D*e).

include_metadata.description: Include metadata about what was redacted (PII type, offset) in the policy result details.

preserve_length.description: When true, the replacement string matches the original length to avoid layout changes.

custom_markers.description: Per-PII-type custom replacement strings. Keys are PII type labels (e.g. 'ssn', 'email'), values are replacement texts.

HipaaPhiDetector.description: Detects HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) using the Safe Harbor de-identification method covering all 18 identifier categories (names, addresses, dates, SSNs, medical record numbers, etc.).

mode.description: Detection mode. 'hipaa_18' scans for all 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor identifier categories.

action.description: Action on PHI detection: 'redact' replaces PHI with placeholder tokens, 'block' rejects the entire request.

HealthcareCompliance.description: Healthcare-specific compliance enforcement: blocks prohibited medical content patterns and injects required FDA/regulatory disclaimers based on device classification.

blocked_patterns.description: Substring patterns that indicate prohibited medical advice or claims (e.g. 'this will cure', 'guaranteed treatment').

required_disclaimers.description: Disclaimer texts to inject into healthcare-related responses. When empty, a default FDA-class-appropriate disclaimer is used.

fda_class.description: FDA device classification tier. Class I: general controls, Class II (default): special controls require disclaimers, Class III: premarket approval with strict blocking.

AuditLogger.description: Audit logger policy marker. Retention, immutability, and storage are externally owned; this block accepts no configuration keys.

BiasMonitor.description: Monitors LLM outputs for bias against protected characteristics. Scores responses and escalates or blocks when bias exceeds the threshold. Especially sensitive in HR contexts (hiring, promotions, performance reviews) with age-discrimination detection.

protected_characteristics.description: Additional protected characteristics to monitor beyond the built-in set (race, gender, religion, disability, age).

threshold.description: Bias score threshold (0–1). Responses scoring at or above this value trigger the configured action. Lower values are more sensitive.

action.description: Action when bias is detected: 'escalate' flags for review, 'block' rejects the response.

HumanOversight.description: Requires human review for specified content categories. Matches patterns in the require_human_for list and escalates or blocks. Configurable confidence threshold, assignee, and timeout for the review workflow.

action.description: What to do when a review-triggering pattern is detected: 'escalate' queues for review, 'block' rejects immediately.

Rbac.description: Role-Based Access Control for LLM requests. Enforces verified identity claims from API token validation or signed assertions. Role-based permissions, data access levels, and minimum-necessary PHI access controls.

deny_if_missing.description: HTTP headers that must be present on every request. Requests missing any of these headers are denied. Authorization must use verified token or signed-assertion claims.

require_auth.description: When true, requires a valid authentication token (Bearer) on every request in addition to the identity headers.

roles.description: Role definitions mapping role names to their permitted actions and topic restrictions.

data_access.description: Per-role data sensitivity access levels controlling what classification of data each role can query.

minimum_necessary.description: HIPAA minimum-necessary controls. When enabled, only roles in allowed_phi_roles may access PHI data.

CjisMode.description: CJIS Security Policy enforcement mode. Requires verified authenticated identity (subject, organization, non-expired proof), configured session freshness, and MFA assurance. Spoofable HeaderSoft identity is rejected. Access logging uses durable WAL delivery.

require_auth.description: Reject requests missing verified authentication. CJIS profiles must not rely on unverified HeaderSoft X-User-ID identity.

access_logging.description: Persist a durable CJIS access decision envelope to the gateway event WAL for every evaluation.

session_timeout_minutes.description: Maximum remaining proof lifetime in minutes. Proofs that remain valid longer than this window fail CJIS session-freshness checks.

required_assurance.description: Minimum verified MFA assurance level required for CJIS admission.

CitationVerifier.description: Verifies citations and references in LLM outputs against source material. Supports external resolution, RAG context grounding, and multiple citation pattern types.

require_sources.description: When true, responses must include at least one citation. Responses without citations fail verification.

require_source_match.description: When true, every extracted citation must match a known source. Unmatched citations trigger the output action.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence score (0–1) for a citation match to be considered verified. Lower values are more permissive.

min_groundedness.description: Minimum RAG groundedness score (0–1). Responses below this score are considered insufficiently grounded in the provided context.

external_resolver.description: Configuration for an external citation verification service used to validate referenced sources.

extract_patterns.description: Citation pattern types to extract from the response: case_law (legal cases), academic (DOI/journal refs), url, quote (inline quotes), statistic (numerical claims).

rag_context.description: RAG context grounding settings. When provided, citations are also verified against the retrieval context.

output_action.description: Action to take on citation verification failure (block, warn, or annotate).

response.description: Response formatting options for citation verification results.

include_verification_report.description: Include a detailed verification report in the policy result showing per-citation match status.

CitationExternalResolver.description: Configuration for an external citation verification service endpoint.

api_key.description: API key for the external resolver. WARNING: Prefer using environment variables instead of embedding raw secrets in configuration files.

QualityScorer.description: Evaluates LLM output quality using configurable assertions, benchmarks, and industry-specific scoring profiles. Supports both deterministic (regex, contains, levenshtein) and LLM-graded (rubric, factuality, G-Eval) assertion types.

mode.description: Quality evaluation timing. `buffer` scores the full upstream response before returning it. `stream_through` proxies SSE immediately and defers scoring to the streaming path.

industry.description: Industry profile name to apply (e.g. 'finance', 'healthcare', 'legal'). Loads preset assertions and thresholds from industry_profiles.

min_output_chars.description: Minimum character count for the LLM output. Responses shorter than this fail the quality check.

min_sentences.description: Minimum sentence count for the LLM output. Responses with fewer sentences fail the quality check.

mock_scoring.description: When true, return synthetic pass scores without running actual assertions. Useful for development and testing.

providers.description: LLM providers used by LLM-graded assertions (e.g. llm-rubric, factuality).

targets.description: LLM providers used by LLM-graded assertions (e.g. llm-rubric, factuality).

benchmarks.description: Named benchmark suites (e.g. 'mmlu', 'truthfulqa') to include in scoring.

bleu_reference.description: Static reference text for BLEU scoring when no RAG documents are available. Used by pipelines without a retrieval context.

assertions.description: Array of assertion rules to evaluate against the LLM output (contains, regex, llm-rubric, factuality, etc.).

thresholds.description: Minimum pass score thresholds for overall and per-assertion-type quality gates.

weights.description: Per-assertion-type scoring weights for the weighted average quality score.

industry_profiles.description: Named industry profiles with preset assertions, thresholds, and weights.

failure_action.description: Action to take when the quality score falls below thresholds (block, warn, or escalate).

pass_policy.description: Policy for determining overall pass/fail from multiple assertions (e.g. all must pass, or any one must pass).

judge.description: Optional LLM-as-a-judge configuration. When enabled, the quality scorer calls a secondary judge model to produce an inference-based score with audit-grade chain-of-thought rationale.

regression_monitoring.description: Regression-monitoring settings for the judge scorer. Controls sampling rate and behavior when running judge scoring in shadow/audit mode.

FlaggedReview.description: Executes an inline secondary review model on the originating request after the primary output is available. Inline execution runs after the primary model output, before the response is returned. Can produce audit-only review metadata, a reviewed response to return to the user, or a terminal escalation decision when review or guard checks fail. Recursion depth is enforced per-request-lineage: exceeding recursion_depth_max escalates the turn. Provider isolation is enforced when provider_isolation=true: a review provider matching the primary upstream provider escalates the turn. Timeouts are strict: exceeded timeout_ms escalates the turn. All terminal guard failures (recursion depth exceeded, provider isolation violation, timeout) MUST persist verdict='escalate' with reviewed_response=null.

mode.description: Inline review mode. 'judge' returns a structured verdict, 'review_and_return' also returns edited output, 'audit_only' records review metadata without changing the runtime verdict, and 'escalate' skips model review and routes the turn for human review.

recursion_depth_max.description: Maximum inline review depth allowed for a single request lineage. Exceeding this limit escalates the turn instead of invoking another model.

provider_isolation.description: When true, the review provider must be different from the primary upstream provider or endpoint. Matching providers escalate the turn instead of performing review.

rationale_capture.description: When true, persist the review model's explicit rationale field when provided.

prompt_template.description: Optional custom inline review prompt template. Use {input}, {output}, {reason_code}, and {mode} placeholders.

FlaggedReviewProvider.description: Secondary review provider configuration for inline flagged-review execution.

name.description: Stable provider identifier persisted in review execution records.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint for the inline review model.

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference whose value is the API bearer token for the review endpoint.

timeout_ms.description: Strict timeout in milliseconds for inline review calls.

RbacRolesSection.description: Map of role names to role definitions. Keys are role identifiers (e.g. 'admin', 'analyst', 'viewer').

RbacDataAccessRule.description: Data access rule defining the maximum data sensitivity level a role may query.

max_sensitivity.description: Maximum data classification this role may access: 'public' < 'internal' < 'confidential' < 'restricted'.

RbacDataAccessSection.description: Map of role names to their data access rules. Keys match role identifiers defined in the roles section.

RbacMinimumNecessarySection.description: HIPAA minimum-necessary access controls restricting PHI access to authorized roles only.

enabled.description: Enable minimum-necessary enforcement. When true, PHI access is restricted to allowed_phi_roles.

allowed_phi_roles.description: Roles permitted to access Protected Health Information. All other roles are denied PHI access.

AgentFirewall.description: Controls which tools AI agents can use, with rate limits, transaction limits, kill switches, and monitoring. Supports a simple flat format or an expanded structured format.

AgentFirewallSimple.description: Simple agent firewall: flat allow/block lists and a session action cap.

allowed_tools.description: Glob patterns for tools the agent may call. '*' allows all tools.

blocked_tools.description: Glob patterns for tools the agent is denied. Takes precedence over allowed_tools.

max_actions_per_session.description: Maximum total tool invocations allowed per agent session.

AgentFirewallExpanded.description: Expanded agent firewall with role-based tool policies, rate limits, financial transaction limits, kill switches, and monitoring.

tools.description: Role-based tool access control. Each role defines its own allowed/denied tool lists.

rate_limits.description: Per-tool rate limits (requests per minute). Keys are tool names, values are integer limits. Use 'default' for the fallback.

max_actions_per_session.description: Maximum total tool invocations allowed per agent session.

transaction_limits.description: Financial transaction limits for agent actions that involve monetary transfers or purchases.

kill_switches.description: Emergency halt conditions to stop runaway agents (error thresholds, PII detection, suspicious patterns).

monitoring.description: Alert and monitoring settings for denied actions, rate limit hits, and usage thresholds.

RoleToolPolicy.description: Per-role tool access control: allowed and denied tool lists for a specific role.

allowed.description: Tool names or glob patterns this role may call.

denied.description: Tool names or glob patterns this role is denied. Takes precedence over allowed.

AgentFirewallToolsSection.description: Role-based tool access control section. Maps role names to their tool allow/deny policies.

roles.description: Map of role names to their tool access policies.

AgentFirewallRateLimitsSection.description: Per-tool rate limits in requests per minute. Keys are tool names; use 'default' for the fallback rate limit.

AgentFirewallTransactionLimitsSection.description: Financial guardrails for agent actions involving monetary transactions.

max_single_transaction.description: Maximum USD amount for any single financial transaction by the agent.

max_daily_total.description: Maximum cumulative USD spend per day across all agent transactions.

require_approval_above.description: Transactions above this USD amount require human approval before execution.

AgentFirewallKillSwitchesSection.description: Emergency halt conditions that stop a runaway agent from further tool invocations.

max_errors_before_halt.description: Consecutive tool call errors that trigger an automatic agent halt.

halt_on_pii_in_action.description: Halt the agent immediately if PII is detected in a tool call's arguments.

halt_on_suspicious_pattern.description: Halt the agent if a suspicious behavioral pattern is detected (e.g. rapid privilege escalation).

AgentFirewallMonitoringSection.description: Monitoring and alerting configuration for agent firewall events.

alert_on_denied_action.description: Send an alert when a tool call is denied by the firewall.

alert_on_rate_limit.description: Send an alert when an agent hits a rate limit.

alert_threshold_percent.description: Usage percentage of max_actions_per_session that triggers a warning alert.

DlpFilter.description: Data Loss Prevention filter. Detects and redacts or blocks sensitive data patterns such as API keys, passwords, internal identifiers, and custom regex patterns.

detect_patterns.description: Custom regex patterns to detect sensitive data (e.g. internal project codes, API key formats). Applied alongside the built-in detectors.

blocked_terms.description: Exact terms to block (e.g. internal product codenames, classified project names). Matched as substrings; supports fuzzy matching when enabled.

action.description: Action on detection: 'redact' masks the sensitive data in-place, 'block' rejects the entire request.

fuzzy_matching.description: Enable Levenshtein-distance fuzzy matching for blocked_terms, catching typos and evasion attempts.

max_distance.description: Maximum edit distance for fuzzy matching. Only effective when fuzzy_matching is true. Higher values catch more variants but increase false positives.

sensitivity_level.description: Detection sensitivity: 'standard' (default), 'high' (more aggressive pattern matching), 'restricted' (strictest, for classified contexts).

ItarEarFilter.description: ITAR/EAR export control filter. Blocks content containing terms from the International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations controlled lists.

blocked_terms.description: Terms from ITAR/EAR controlled lists (e.g. weapons systems, military technology, dual-use items). Matched as substrings.

action.description: Action on detection. Always 'block' — export-controlled content must not be transmitted.

fuzzy_matching.description: Enable Levenshtein-distance fuzzy matching to catch misspellings of controlled terms.

max_distance.description: Maximum edit distance for fuzzy matching. Only effective when fuzzy_matching is true.

EntityListFilter.description: Sanctions and denied-party entity list filter. Blocks content referencing entities on configured watchlists (OFAC SDN, EU sanctions, BIS Entity List, etc.).

blocked_entities.description: Entity names to screen for (organizations, individuals, aliases). Matched as substrings with optional fuzzy matching.

action.description: Action on detection. Always 'block' — transactions with sanctioned entities are prohibited.

fuzzy_matching.description: Enable Levenshtein-distance fuzzy matching to catch transliterations and spelling variations of entity names.

max_distance.description: Maximum edit distance for fuzzy matching. Only effective when fuzzy_matching is true.

DualUseFilter.description: Dual-use goods filter. Detects and blocks or redacts references to items with both civilian and military applications (Wassenaar Arrangement, EU Dual-Use Regulation).

blocked_terms.description: Terms designating dual-use items (e.g. 'centrifuge', 'night vision', 'encryption hardware'). Matched as substrings.

action.description: Action when dual-use content is detected: 'block' rejects the request, 'redact' masks the matched terms.

fuzzy_matching.description: Enable Levenshtein-distance fuzzy matching to catch misspellings of dual-use terms.

max_distance.description: Maximum edit distance for fuzzy matching. Only effective when fuzzy_matching is true.

EmbeddingDetectorPolicy.description: Embedding-based semantic detector. Uses vector similarity to detect sensitive content categories (PII, PHI, MNPI, prompt injection, export-controlled data) via local or external embedding models.

backend.description: Embedding backend: 'local' uses a built-in model, 'external' calls the configured endpoint.

endpoint.description: URL of the external embedding service. Used when backend is 'external'.

model.description: Embedding model name for the external backend.

api_key.description: API key for the external embedding backend. WARNING: Prefer using environment variables instead of embedding raw secrets in configuration files.

similarity_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold above which content is flagged as matching a sensitive category.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for embedding computation or external API calls.

action.description: Action when sensitive content is detected: 'redact' masks the content, 'block' rejects the request.

categories.description: Additional custom sensitive categories to detect alongside the built-in defaults (PII, PHI, financial, biometric, prompt injection, export-controlled).

EmbeddingSensitiveCategory.description: A custom sensitive content category for embedding-based detection.

label.description: Identifier for this category, used in detection output (e.g. 'trade_secrets').

reference_text.description: Representative text for this category. Content is compared against this via embedding similarity.

FinancialCompliance.description: Financial industry compliance enforcement. Blocks prohibited financial advice patterns and injects required regulatory disclaimers (e.g. 'This is not financial advice').

blocked_patterns.description: Substring patterns that indicate prohibited financial advice (e.g. 'guaranteed returns', 'you should invest in'). Content matching any pattern is blocked.

required_disclaimers.description: Disclaimer texts to inject into responses. When empty, falls back to the built-in default: 'This is not financial advice.'

MnpiFilter.description: Material Non-Public Information filter. Detects and blocks content containing insider trading risk patterns such as unannounced earnings, merger details, or board decisions.

detect_patterns.description: Substring patterns indicating MNPI risk. Built-in defaults include 'earnings before announcement', 'merger not public', 'insider information', 'board decision', 'not public'.

action.description: Action when MNPI is detected. Always 'block' — insider information must never pass through.

LegalPrivilege.description: Attorney-client privilege protection. Detects and blocks content containing legal privilege markers to prevent inadvertent waiver.

privilege_markers.description: Substring patterns indicating privileged communication. Built-in defaults include 'attorney-client privilege', 'privileged and confidential', 'work product', 'for legal review only'.

action.description: Action when privilege markers are detected. Always 'block' — privileged content must not be disclosed.

UplFilter.description: Unauthorized Practice of Law filter. Detects legal advice patterns and optionally injects 'not legal advice' disclaimers or rewrites to educational framing.

blocked_patterns.description: Substring patterns that indicate unauthorized legal advice (e.g. 'you should sue', 'file this motion'). Built-in defaults apply when empty.

require_disclaimer.description: Inject a 'this is not legal advice' disclaimer when legal-adjacent content is detected.

rewrite_to_educational.description: Instead of blocking, rewrite the response with an educational framing prefix. Takes precedence over blocking when enabled.

StudentPrivacy.description: FERPA/COPPA student privacy protection. Detects and redacts student education records (grades, enrollment, disciplinary) and enforces age-gating for minors.

action.description: Action when student data is detected: 'redact' masks the data in-place, 'block' rejects the entire request.

age_gate.description: Enable age verification gating. When true, requests involving minors (under 13 for COPPA, under 18 for FERPA) receive additional protections.

SafetyFilter.description: Industry-specific safety filter with modes for critical infrastructure, automotive, education, and law enforcement. Blocks hazardous content patterns with optional fuzzy matching and age-appropriate filtering.

mode.description: Industry mode that selects the built-in set of hazardous content patterns. Each mode loads domain-specific block lists.

block_if.description: Additional custom patterns to block, appended to the mode's built-in patterns. Matched as substrings (or fuzzy when enabled).

action.description: Action when hazardous content is detected: 'block' rejects the request, 'escalate' flags for review.

fuzzy_matching.description: Enable Levenshtein-distance fuzzy matching to catch typos and evasion attempts on block_if patterns.

max_distance.description: Maximum edit distance for fuzzy matching. Only effective when fuzzy_matching is true.

max_age.description: Maximum audience age for content filtering. When >0 and <18, enables age-inappropriate content detection (e.g. for education environments).

CasePrivacy.description: Legal case privacy protection. Detects and redacts case numbers, court filing identifiers, and other configurable legal document patterns.

detect_patterns.description: Pattern categories to detect. Built-in: 'case_number' matches court case identifiers. Custom regex patterns can also be added.

action.description: Action when case identifiers are detected. Currently only 'redact' is supported.

PromptInjectionDetectionSection.description: Detection tuning for prompt injection: embedding similarity threshold and custom attack patterns.

PromptInjectionEncodingSection.description: Encoding evasion defenses: base64 decoding, Unicode normalization, and homoglyph detection.

PromptInjectionBoundariesSection.description: Boundary enforcement: delimiter validation and fake boundary rejection.

PromptInjectionResponseSection.description: Customizes the response returned when a prompt injection is detected.

message.default: Request blocked: potential prompt injection detected

default.message: Request blocked: potential prompt injection detected

CitationVerificationSection.description: Verification settings for citation accuracy: source matching, groundedness scoring, and citation pattern extraction.

CitationRagContextSection.description: RAG context grounding settings for citation verification.

CitationOutputActionSection.description: Actions to take on unverified or hallucinated citations in the output.

QualityBenchmarksSection.description: Toggle standard quality benchmarks (RAGAS faithfulness/relevancy, BLEU, NLI entailment, coherence, completeness).

QualityProviderTarget.description: An LLM provider used by quality assertions. Either a string provider ID or an object with provider/model/base_url/secret_key_ref fields.

QualityScorerJudgeConfig.description: LLM-as-a-judge configuration for the quality scorer. When enabled, invokes a secondary judge model for inference-based scoring with audit-grade rationale capture.

enabled.description: Enable judge-backed scoring. When false, the judge section is entirely ignored.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint for the judge model.

model.description: Model identifier to use for judge inference (e.g. 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022').

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference whose value is the API bearer token for the judge endpoint.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds for judge calls. Errors are non-fatal — the main request path continues.

threshold.description: Score at or above which the judge verdict is 'pass'.

warn_threshold.description: Score between warn_threshold and threshold yields a 'warn' verdict. Scores below warn_threshold yield 'fail'.

rationale_capture.description: When true, store the explicit rationale text emitted by the judge in the audit record (SEC-004 compliant: only the judge's stated rationale field is captured, never opaque internal reasoning).

prompt_template.description: Custom scoring prompt template. Use {input}, {output}, and {rubric} as placeholders. When omitted the default rubric-evaluation prompt is used.

sampling_rate.description: Fraction of requests for which the judge is invoked [0, 1]. Set below 1.0 to use the judge in regression-monitoring sampling mode.

scorer_name.description: Scorer identity name persisted in audit records.

scorer_version.description: Scorer version string persisted in audit records.

QualityScorerRegressionMonitoringConfig.description: Regression-monitoring settings for the quality scorer judge. Allows running judge scoring at a sub-100% sampling rate for statistical monitoring without blocking every request.

enabled.description: Enable regression monitoring mode. When true, judge results are logged as audit events but do not affect the enforcement verdict.

sample_rate.description: Fraction of requests evaluated by the judge in monitoring mode [0, 1]. Overrides judge.sampling_rate when regression_monitoring.enabled is true.

alert_threshold.description: Average judge score below which an alert is triggered in monitoring mode.

IsRefusalAssertionConfig.description: Configuration for the is-refusal assertion. Detects whether the LLM output is a refusal (e.g. 'I can’t assist with that') by matching known refusal phrases and checking the finish reason.

expected.description: When true (default), the assertion passes if the output IS a refusal. When false, the assertion passes if the output is NOT a refusal.

QualityAssertion.description: A single quality assertion that evaluates LLM output. The type field determines which config schema applies via conditional sub-schemas.

type.description: The assertion type. Determines what check is performed and which config shape is expected.

name.description: A human-readable label for this assertion instance.

enabled.description: Whether this assertion is active. Disabled assertions are skipped during evaluation.

threshold.description: Minimum score (0–1) for this assertion to pass.

weight.description: Weight of this assertion in the aggregate quality score.

config.description: Type-specific configuration. Shape varies by assertion type (see conditional sub-schemas).

mode.description: Whether the assertion is enforced or only monitored.

severity.description: Failure severity: warning logs but passes, error fails the quality gate.

pack.description: Name of an assertion_packs entry to inline.

fallback_message.default: I apologize, but I cannot provide a sufficiently accurate response to this query.

default.fallback_message: I apologize, but I cannot provide a sufficiently accurate response to this query.

ProvidersSection.description: LLM provider configuration: targets (endpoints), routing strategy, fallback behavior, context compression, circuit breakers, retry policy, and observability controls.

targets.description: One or more LLM provider endpoints. The first target is the primary; others are used for fallback, routing, or A/B testing.

fallback.description: Controls automatic failover behavior when the primary provider returns errors.

routing.description: Provider selection strategy (ordered, round-robin, latency-based, semantic, etc.) and filtering constraints.

context_compression.description: Automatic conversation truncation when messages exceed provider context limits.

zero_completion_insurance.description: Protection against zero-token completions that still incur billing.

model_groups.description: Named groups of provider targets for virtual model routing

pipelines.description: Named virtual models that orchestrate multiple provider targets in sequence or fan-out modes

circuit_breaker.description: Per-provider circuit breaker that opens after consecutive failures.

retry_policy.description: Global and per-trigger retry configuration with backoff strategy.

scope_rate_limits.description: Aggregate rate limits segmented by API key, user, team, and global scopes.

traffic_mirror.description: Silent traffic mirroring to a shadow provider for testing or comparison.

ab_test.description: A/B testing configuration for comparing provider variants.

logging.description: Controls redaction of sensitive data in gateway trace spans and event payloads.

ProviderTarget.description: A single LLM provider endpoint with connection details, authentication, and optional execution-target or native-execution configuration.

id.description: Unique identifier for this provider target

provider.description: Provider name or Verdictan-style provider spec (e.g. openai, openai:responses:gpt-5, openrouter:chat:google/gemini-2.5-pro, groq:responses:openai/gpt-oss-120b, togetherai:embedding:BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, mistral:embedding:mistral-embed, anthropic, cloudflare-ai:chat:@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b, snowflake:mistral-large2)

model.description: Model identifier to use. Optional when the provider field already includes a Verdictan-style model spec. Canonical shorthand families can also default base_url and secret_key_ref when omitted, for example openai:* -> https://api.openai.com / OPENAI_API_KEY, openrouter:* -> https://openrouter.ai/api / OPENROUTER_API_KEY, groq:* -> https://api.groq.com/openai / GROQ_API_KEY, togetherai:* -> https://api.together.xyz / TOGETHER_API_KEY, and mistral:* -> https://api.mistral.ai / MISTRAL_API_KEY.

description.description: Natural-language description of the workloads this target is best suited for; used by semantic routing.

adapter_command.description: Local adapter executable used for execution-target providers such as browser, chatkit, claude-agent-sdk, codex-sdk, or an explicit adapter-backed MCP bridge.

adapter_args.description: Arguments passed to adapter_command for execution-target providers.

adapter_cwd.description: Optional working directory for adapter-backed or exec/file execution targets.

adapter_env.description: Optional environment variables injected into the execution-target adapter process.

execution_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for local execution targets such as exec:, file://, and adapter-backed browser or SDK providers.

path_to_claude_code_executable.description: Optional native execution path for anthropic:claude-agent-sdk or anthropic:claude-code targets when Verdictan should invoke a local Claude executable directly.

codex_path_override.description: Optional native execution path for openai:codex-sdk or openai:codex targets when Verdictan should invoke a local Codex executable directly.

working_dir.description: Optional working directory for native Claude or Codex execution runtimes. Also used as the default current directory when adapter_cwd is omitted.

additional_directories.description: Additional directories exposed to native Claude or Codex execution runtimes.

cli_env.description: Optional environment variables passed to native Claude or Codex execution runtimes. Merged with adapter_env when both are set.

permission_mode.description: Claude Agent SDK native-execution permission mode, for example default, plan, acceptEdits, bypassPermissions, or dontAsk.

append_allowed_tools.description: Claude Agent SDK native-execution tools appended to the default allow-list.

disallowed_tools.description: Claude Agent SDK native-execution tools to block explicitly.

allow_all_tools.description: Claude Agent SDK native-execution flag that permits all available tools.

fallback_model.description: Claude Agent SDK fallback model when the primary model fails.

max_turns.description: Claude Agent SDK maximum conversation turns for a native-execution invocation.

sandbox_mode.description: Codex native-execution sandbox mode, for example read-only, workspace-write, or danger-full-access.

approval_policy.description: Codex native-execution approval policy, for example never, on-request, on-failure, or untrusted.

network_access_enabled.description: Codex native-execution flag that permits outbound network access.

web_search_enabled.description: Codex native-execution flag that permits web search.

skip_git_repo_check.description: Codex native-execution flag that skips the default Git repository safety check.

mcp.description: Native MCP bridge settings used when provider is 'mcp' and requests are forwarded directly over HTTP.

api_key_header.description: HTTP header for the API key

api_key_prefix.description: Prefix before the API key value

cloudflare_account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID used to derive the Workers AI base URL

cloudflare_account_id_env.description: Environment variable name that contains the Cloudflare account ID

snowflake_account_identifier.description: Snowflake account identifier used to derive the Cortex base URL

snowflake_account_identifier_env.description: Environment variable name that contains the Snowflake account identifier

stream_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for streaming requests. Falls back to timeout_seconds if not set.

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum context tokens for this provider (triggers compression)

max_messages.description: Maximum message count for this provider

pricing.description: Pricing information for cost-based routing and spend tracking. Canonical fields are input_price_per_million / output_price_per_million (USD per 1M tokens). Legacy prompt/completion fields are still accepted and used as fallbacks.

prompt.description: Legacy: cost per prompt token in USD. Superseded by input_price_per_million.

completion.description: Legacy: cost per completion token in USD. Superseded by output_price_per_million.

input_price_per_million.description: USD cost per 1 million input (prompt) tokens. Takes precedence over prompt when present.

cached_input_price_per_million.description: USD cost per 1 million cached input tokens. Defaults to input_price_per_million when absent.

output_price_per_million.description: USD cost per 1 million output (completion) tokens. Takes precedence over completion when present.

input_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to input tokens before computing cost (default 1.0).

cached_input_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to cached input tokens before computing cost (default 1.0).

output_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to output tokens before computing cost (default 1.0).

models.description: Nested model entries for multi-model provider targets. When present, the top-level 'model' field is ignored and routing resolves against this list. Each entry inherits parent pricing when its own pricing is absent.

aliases.description: Alternative model names that resolve to this entry.

enabled.description: Whether this model is available for routing. Disabled models are skipped.

description.description: Natural-language description used by semantic routing.

supported_features.description: Optional catalog-derived capability flags for this model. When present, the gateway can reject unsupported request shapes before dispatch (for example tools, json_object, json_schema).

max_output_tokens.description: Optional per-model completion ceiling used to reject requests whose max_tokens, max_completion_tokens, or max_output_tokens exceed the resolved model limit.

parameter_overrides.description: Optional model-specific request overrides applied after request translation and before upstream dispatch. Values may be static JSON values or an object with copy_from/default keys to copy from the client request body.

removed_params.description: Optional list of provider request parameters to silently remove for this model before upstream dispatch.

pricing.description: Model-level pricing override. Falls back to parent ProviderTarget pricing when absent.

prompt.description: Legacy: cost per prompt token in USD.

completion.description: Legacy: cost per completion token in USD.

input_price_per_million.description: USD cost per 1 million input tokens.

cached_input_price_per_million.description: USD cost per 1 million cached input tokens.

output_price_per_million.description: USD cost per 1 million output tokens.

escalation_routing.description: Route escalations for this specific model to a team queue or user. Takes precedence over provider-level escalation_routing.

team_id.description: UUID of the team for model-level escalation routing.

user_id.description: UUID of the user for direct assignment of model-level escalations.

data_collection.description: Whether this provider may collect data for analytics

region.description: Geographic region identifier for this provider (e.g. 'us-east', 'eu-west')

data_residency.description: Data-residency pin for this provider target. When present it is authoritative for region eligibility: providers.routing.require_region keeps this target only when require_region appears in regions, and the region field above cannot widen it. If require_region excludes every target and any target declares data_residency, the gateway blocks the request with HTTP 451 and code no_compliant_provider.

regions.description: Regions this endpoint is allowed to serve, matched case-insensitively against providers.routing.require_region. An empty list would exclude every request, so at least one region is required.

data_center_locations.description: Operator-declared data-center locations for audit evidence. Recorded for review and not used for routing.

sovereignty_compliant.description: Operator-declared sovereignty attestation for audit evidence. Recorded for review and not used for routing.

quantizations.description: Quantization formats supported by this provider target

format.description: Wire format this provider uses natively; enables Phase 15 auto-translation

aws_region.description: AWS region for Bedrock; overrides AWS_REGION env var

aws_profile.description: AWS profile name for Bedrock credential resolution

bedrock_model_family.description: Exact Bedrock request contract family allowed by the UDR provider pipeline

watsonx_api_version.description: IBM watsonx API version injected into chat and chat_stream endpoints

watsonx_project_id.description: IBM watsonx project id injected server-side; mutually exclusive with watsonx_space_id

watsonx_space_id.description: IBM watsonx space id injected server-side; mutually exclusive with watsonx_project_id

gcp_project.description: GCP project ID for Vertex AI

gcp_region.description: GCP region for Vertex AI (default: us-central1)

azure_deployment.description: Azure OpenAI deployment name (defaults to model name if not set)

allow_insecure_tls.description: Explicit opt-in to skip TLS certificate verification for this target. Use only for development/testing.

escalation_routing.description: Route escalations from this provider to a specific team queue or directly to a user. Exactly one of team_id or user_id must be set. Model-level escalation_routing takes precedence over provider-level.

team_id.description: UUID of the team that should receive escalations from this provider. All team members are notified and the escalation enters the team queue.

user_id.description: UUID of the user to directly assign escalations to. The escalation is created pre-claimed and only this user is notified.

trigger_on.description: Upstream response classes that permit a retry on the next eligible provider target. auth_error is opt-in and is excluded from the default list.

max_fallback_attempts.description: Maximum number of fallback attempts before giving up

replacement_model.description: Re-route to this model on content filter trigger

custom_response_template.description: Return this template as the response body instead of retrying

overflow_strategy.description: Strategy when context length is exceeded

overflow_model.description: Target model for switch_model strategy (must have larger context window)

strategy.description: Provider selection strategy. ordered: try in declaration order. lowest_latency/highest_throughput: adaptive performance-based. round_robin/weighted_round_robin: deterministic rotation. least_connections/least_busy: load-based. random/simple_shuffle: uniform random. semantic: embedding-based routing using provider descriptions. usage_based: route to provider with lowest cumulative token usage in the measurement window.

window_seconds.description: Measurement window for adaptive strategies (latency, throughput, usage)

min_sample_count.description: Minimum samples before adaptive strategies kick in

exploration_ratio.description: Fraction of requests that explore non-optimal providers for adaptive strategies

order.description: Explicit provider ID ordering override. All IDs must exist in targets.

allow_fallbacks.description: Whether to attempt fallback providers on failure

only.description: Whitelist of provider IDs — only these are eligible (mutually exclusive with ignore)

ignore.description: Blacklist of provider IDs — these are excluded (mutually exclusive with only)

max_price.description: Maximum acceptable per-request cost for provider selection (USD)

prompt.description: Max per-request cost attributable to prompt tokens (USD)

completion.description: Max per-request cost attributable to completion tokens (USD)

preferred_max_latency.description: SLA: deprioritize providers with latency above this threshold

preferred_min_throughput.description: SLA: deprioritize providers with throughput below this threshold

require_region.description: Only route to providers whose region matches this value

require_quantizations.description: Only route to providers supporting at least one of these quantization formats

semantic_embedding_provider.description: Provider ID used for embedding-based semantic routing. When omitted, Verdictan falls back to local lexical similarity.

semantic_similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity score required before semantic routing reorders a provider to the front.

enable_pre_call_checks.description: When true, estimate prompt tokens before routing and skip providers whose max_context_tokens is smaller than the estimate.

ProviderContextCompression.description: Configuration for context window compression when messages exceed provider limits

strategy.description: middle_out: remove messages from the middle of the conversation. oldest_first: remove oldest messages first.

preserve_system_message.description: Always keep the system message when truncating

preserve_first_n.description: Number of earliest messages to preserve

preserve_last_n.description: Number of most recent messages to preserve

max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to keep after compression

message_compression_strategy.description: How to compress individual messages when needed

ProviderZeroCompletionInsurance.description: Protection against zero-token or error-finish completions that still incur billing

conditions.description: Which conditions trigger the insurance action

action.description: Action to take on zero-completion detection

retry_with_fallback.description: When action=retry, also try fallback providers

DataPolicy.description: Data handling and retention policy metadata for a provider target

zero_data_retention.description: Provider guarantees no data is stored

training_opt_out.description: Provider will not use data for training

retention_days.description: Maximum days the provider retains data (0 = no retention)

in_memory_only.description: Provider guarantees payloads are processed in memory only and not written to persistent storage.

sanitized.description: Provider endpoint sanitizes sensitive content before persistence or forwarding.

accepts_tokenized_input.description: Provider accepts tokenized payloads in place of raw sensitive values.

allow_internet_egress.description: Whether the provider target allows internet egress during inference or data processing.

local_only_processing.description: Provider processes requests locally without external network calls.

DataRoutingPolicy.description: Controls which providers are eligible based on their data handling policies

require_zero_data_retention.description: Only route to providers with zero data retention

require_no_training.description: Only route to providers that opt out of training

on_no_compliant_provider.description: Action when no provider meets requirements

log_provider_selection.description: Log which providers were excluded and why

require_in_memory_only.description: Only route to providers that declare in_memory_only: true.

sanitize_before_provider.description: Only route to providers that declare sanitized: true.

tokenize_sensitive_fields.description: Only route to providers that declare accepts_tokenized_input: true.

allow_internet_egress.description: When false, exclude providers that allow internet egress.

local_only_processing.description: Only route to providers that declare local_only_processing: true.

ConsumerGroupsSection.description: API key-based consumer groups for per-group rate limits, policy chains, and upstream routing.

key_header.description: Header used to resolve consumer identity. Authorization expects a Bearer token; custom headers use the raw value.

ConsumerGroupRule.description: A named consumer group with associated API keys, optional rate limit, per-group chain, and upstream target.

ConsumerGroupRateLimitConfig.description: Per-consumer-group rate limit. At least one of max_requests or max_tokens must be specified.

max_requests.description: Maximum requests allowed for this consumer group within the window.

max_tokens.description: Reserved for future token-based consumer group ceilings.

window_seconds.description: Fixed-window length in seconds for this consumer group.

RouteRule.description: A path-based routing rule that maps incoming requests to upstream targets with optional per-route policy chains.

SemanticCacheConfig.description: Semantic or exact-match response caching configuration. Note: the cache storage backend is configured exclusively via environment variables. Memory and filesystem are local-node backends. `redis` and `qdrant` provide shared semantic-capable backends. `s3` and `gcs` provide shared exact-cache storage only. All shared backends require a CLI build with `--features distributed`.

mode.description: exact: hash-based key match. semantic: embedding-based cosine similarity (requires embedding_provider).

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity for a cache hit in semantic mode

embedding_provider.description: Provider target ID whose /v1/embeddings endpoint computes embeddings. Required when mode=semantic.

default_on.description: When true, cache is always active. When false, only activates if the request includes x-verdictan-cache: on header.

LanguageValidatorPolicy.description: Enforces language restrictions on request/response content. Blocks or warns when detected language does not match the allowed/denied lists.

allowed_languages.description: ISO 639-1 language codes permitted (e.g. ['en', 'fr', 'de']). Empty means all languages are allowed unless denied.

denied_languages.description: ISO 639-1 language codes to block. Takes precedence over allowed_languages when both are set.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence score for the language detection result to trigger enforcement. Lower values are more aggressive.

action.description: Action when a language violation is detected: 'block' rejects the request, 'warn' logs and allows.

apply_to.description: Which direction to validate: 'input' (requests only), 'output' (responses only), 'both'.

ExternalModerationPolicy.description: Routes content through external moderation services for analysis. Supports OpenAI Moderation, Azure Content Safety, AWS Bedrock Guardrails, Presidio, Guardrails AI, Dynamo AI, Lakera, custom webhook, and embedding-based endpoints.

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference holding the API key

fail_closed.description: When true, block on provider errors; when false, allow

aws_access_key_env.description: Environment variable for AWS access key

aws_secret_key_env.description: Environment variable for AWS secret key

aws_session_token_env.description: Environment variable for AWS session token

reference_texts.description: Reference texts for embedding similarity comparison

presidio_language.description: Language hint for Presidio analyzer (e.g. en)

BotDetectorPolicy.description: Request fingerprinting and automated abuse detection. Identifies bot-like request patterns based on header similarity within a rolling window.

fingerprint_fields.description: HTTP headers used to construct the request fingerprint. Similar fingerprints within the window are flagged.

profile_window_seconds.description: Rolling time window (in seconds) used for fingerprint comparison and request counting.

similarity_threshold.description: Fingerprint similarity score (0–1) above which requests are considered from the same bot. Higher values require closer matches.

max_requests_per_window.description: Maximum requests from a similar fingerprint in one window before triggering the action.

action.description: Action when bot-like behavior is detected: 'warn' logs the detection, 'block' rejects the request.

ContentExtractorPolicy.description: URL and document content extraction policy. Fetches and injects referenced content from allowed hosts with size and timeout limits.

allow_hosts.description: Hostnames the extractor is permitted to fetch from (e.g. ['docs.example.com']). Empty blocks all fetches.

timeout_ms.description: HTTP fetch timeout in milliseconds per URL.

max_bytes.description: Maximum response body size in bytes. Larger documents are truncated.

fetch_urls.description: Whether to automatically fetch URLs found in the request and inject their content.

action_on_error.description: Action when a URL fetch fails: 'warn' logs the error and continues, 'block' rejects the request.

DocumentAnalyzerPolicy.description: Analyzes uploaded documents for content policy compliance. Validates MIME types, enforces size limits, and optionally sanitizes embedded code.

enabled.description: Enable or disable document analysis. When false, documents pass through without inspection.

sanitize_code.description: When true, run the code-sanitizer on code blocks extracted from documents.

max_document_bytes.description: Maximum document size in bytes (default 512 KB). Documents exceeding this are rejected.

allowed_mime_types.description: Permitted MIME types (e.g. ['application/pdf', 'text/plain']). Empty means all types are allowed.

CodeSanitizerPolicy.description: Scans code blocks in request/response for dangerous patterns (shell injection, file system access, network calls) and optionally blocks or sanitizes.

enabled.description: Enable or disable code scanning. When false, the policy is a no-op.

block_on_match.description: When true, block the entire request/response if a dangerous pattern is found. When false, strip the offending code block.

additional_patterns.description: Custom regex patterns to detect alongside built-in checks (shell injection, fs access, network calls). Each pattern is scanned within extracted code blocks.

ToolValidationPolicy.description: Validates AI agent tool calls against declared schemas. Optionally uses semantic validation via an LLM endpoint to detect misuse.

declared_tools.description: Allowlisted tool names the agent is permitted to call. Tool calls not on this list are denied unless allow_undeclared is true.

schemas.description: JSON Schema definitions for each tool's expected arguments. Keys are tool names, values are JSON Schema objects. Arguments are validated against these schemas.

allow_undeclared.description: When true, tool calls not in declared_tools are allowed but logged. When false, undeclared tool calls are blocked.

semantic_validation.description: Optional LLM-based semantic validation to detect tool call misuse beyond schema conformance (e.g. data exfiltration via legitimate API calls).

enabled.description: Enable semantic validation. When true, tool call intent is analyzed by the configured LLM.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint for the validation LLM (e.g. 'https://api.openai.com/v1').

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference containing the API key for the validation endpoint. Avoids embedding secrets in config.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the semantic validation LLM call.

ToolSecurityPolicy.description: Security analysis for AI agent tool calls. Supports local static analysis or forwarding to an external firewall endpoint.

analysis_mode.description: Analysis mode: 'local' runs built-in static analysis rules, 'external' forwards tool calls to the firewall_endpoint for analysis.

firewall_endpoint.description: External tool-call firewall endpoint URL. Required when analysis_mode is 'external'. Receives tool call payloads and returns allow/deny decisions.

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference containing the API key for the external firewall endpoint.

fail_closed.description: When true, tool calls are blocked if the external firewall is unavailable or returns an invalid response.

blocked_entity_types.description: Optional list of high-risk entity types that should trigger a local tool-security block when detected in the request payload. Empty uses the built-in defaults such as pan, ssn, jwt, aws_access_key, mrn, and private_key.

blocked_patterns.description: Operator-defined pattern strings that trigger a local tool-security block when any pattern is found (case-insensitive substring match) in the serialized tool call request payload.

McpBridgeConfig.description: Native MCP bridge settings for protocol-aware HTTP forwarding and bridge-time tool governance.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version recorded in the MCP request metadata emitted by the Verdictan bridge.

session_id.description: Optional operator-defined session identifier propagated into MCP request metadata.

tool_validation.description: Tool allowlist and schema validation enforced before a tools/call frame leaves the MCP bridge.

tool_security.description: Argument-level security checks enforced before a tools/call frame leaves the MCP bridge.

ToolBudgetPolicy.description: Per-tool token and cost budgets for AI agent tool calls. Enforces maximum token consumption and USD spending per tool.

max_tokens.description: Maximum total tokens this tool may consume across all invocations in a session.

budgets.description: Map of tool names to their budget limits. Each entry defines token and/or cost caps for a specific tool.

GdprCompliancePolicy.description: GDPR consent management. Checks for consent headers and detects erasure requests.

consent_required.description: Whether a valid consent header is required on every request.

consent_header.description: HTTP header name containing the consent token.

data_categories.description: Personal data categories governed by this policy.

EuAiActPolicy.description: Reporting-only EU AI Act gap-report configuration. Consumed by POST /verdictan/compliance/report to check whether the executable policy chain covers required Articles (9–15). Not an inline enforcement policy.

risk_class.description: AI system risk classification recorded in the compliance report.

articles.description: EU AI Act article numbers included in the compliance report. Defaults to all high-risk articles (9–15).

action.description: Accepted configuration field only; it does not change inline enforcement or report generation.

AssertionMode.description: enforce: failures block the response; audit: logged but non-blocking; shadow: run silently, no output

AssertionSeverity.description: critical: used together with enforce mode to block; warning/info are informational only

strategy.description: all: every enforce+critical assertion must pass; quorum: at least quorum% must pass; weighted_average: weighted score >= threshold

quorum.description: Required fraction of assertions that must pass when strategy=quorum (e.g. 0.8 = 80%)

threshold.description: Weighted average score threshold when strategy=weighted_average

AssertionPacksSection.description: Named reusable assertion bundles that can be referenced via pack: <name> in assertion lists

TestingSection.description: Declarative test configuration. Define test suites with cases and assertions to validate policy behavior.

default_threshold.description: Default threshold applied to assertions that do not specify their own

TestSuite.description: A named test suite containing test cases and optional suite-level assertions.

TestCase.description: A single test case with input messages, expected verdict, and optional per-case assertions.

TestCaseInput.description: Input data for a test case: messages, headers, raw request body, or upstream response to simulate.

gateway_name.description: Gateway instance name to simulate for policy-targeting evaluation.

team_slugs.description: Team slugs to simulate for team-scoped policy-targeting evaluation.

TestMessage.description: A single chat message in a test case input.

TestCaseExpected.description: Expected outcome of a test case: the enforcement verdict and reason code.

TestAssertion.description: A quality assertion applied in a test suite or test case.

pack.description: Name of an assertion_packs entry to inline

TokenRateLimitConfig.description: Limit total LLM token consumption within a sliding window.

max_tokens.description: Maximum total tokens allowed within the window.

scope.description: Bucketing scope: global, per API key, or per client IP.

RequestRateLimitConfig.description: Global request-count ceiling over a fixed window.

max_requests.description: Maximum requests allowed within the window.
Maximum requests per IP within the window.

trusted_proxy_cidrs.description: IPv4 or IPv6 CIDRs of proxies authorized to append X-Forwarded-For. Resolution walks right-to-left only while each hop is trusted.

UserRateLimitConfig.description: Per-user request-count ceiling using request header bucketing.

max_requests.description: Maximum requests per resolved user within the window.

header_names.description: Header names checked in order to resolve the user identity bucket.

IpAllowlistConfig.description: Optional source IP allowlist enforced before request forwarding.

cidrs.description: Allowed CIDR blocks or single IP addresses.

trusted_proxy_cidrs.description: IPv4 or IPv6 CIDRs of proxies authorized to append X-Forwarded-For. An untrusted socket peer cannot override its address.

CorsConfig.description: Optional runtime CORS policy applied to gateway endpoints.

SizeLimitsConfig.description: Byte-level limits on request body, headers, and URL.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum request body size in bytes.

max_header_bytes.description: Maximum total header block size in bytes.

max_response_bytes.description: Maximum response body size in bytes. Responses exceeding this are rejected with 502.

ModelGroup.description: A virtual model name that maps to an ordered list of provider targets with optional aliases and fallback groups.

name.description: Group name used as virtual model name in requests

targets.description: Ordered list of provider target IDs

aliases.description: Alternative names that also resolve to this group

fallback_group.description: Name of the next model group to try when all targets in this group fail

ProviderPipeline.description: A named virtual model that orchestrates multiple provider targets together as a sequence or fan-out pipeline.

name.description: Pipeline name used as the request model identifier

mode.description: Execution mode. sequence runs steps one after another; fan_out executes all steps against the same original request.

aliases.description: Alternative names that also resolve to this pipeline.

aggregation.description: Fan-out output aggregation strategy. concat combines all successful step outputs in order. first_success returns the first successful step output in config order.

ProviderPipelineStep.description: One provider target invocation inside a pipeline.

name.description: Optional human-readable step label used in pipeline metadata and fan-out aggregation output.

target.description: Configured provider target ID to invoke for this step.

instruction.description: Optional step-scoped instruction injected ahead of the request before the step runs.

input_mode.description: For sequence steps after the first, controls whether the previous step output is appended to or replaces the original request payload.

inject_as.description: Role used when injecting the previous sequence step output into the next step request.

CircuitBreakerConfig.description: Per-provider circuit breaker that opens after consecutive failures and probes for recovery.

enabled.description: Kill-switch to disable the circuit breaker

cooldown_seconds.description: Seconds to wait in open state before half-open probe

half_open_successes.description: Successes needed in half-open to close

RetryPolicy.description: Global and per-trigger retry policy with configurable backoff strategy.

per_trigger.description: Per-trigger retry limits. Keys are FallbackTrigger values (rate_limit, server_error, timeout, context_length_exceeded, content_filter, model_not_found)

base_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds for exponential backoff (delay = base_ms * 2^attempt)

delay_ms.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between retries (used when strategy=fixed)

ProviderScopeRateLimits.description: Aggregate rate limits segmented by key, user, team, and global scopes within the providers section

max_parallel_requests.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight requests across all providers

ProviderTrafficMirror.description: Silent traffic mirroring to a shadow model for testing or comparison

mirror_target.description: Provider target ID to mirror traffic to

log_mirror_response.description: Whether to log the mirror response for comparison

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for the mirror request in milliseconds

ProviderAbTest.description: A/B testing configuration for provider selection

provider_id.description: Provider target ID for this variant

variants.description: A/B test variants with provider IDs and weights

sticky_by.description: How to assign users to variants persistently. user_id: based on user header. key_id: based on API key. random: no stickiness.

ProviderLogging.description: Controls what information is redacted from gateway trace spans and event payloads

redact_message_bodies.description: When true, message content fields are replaced with [REDACTED] in traces/events

redact_api_keys.description: When true, API key values are replaced with [REDACTED] in traces/events

DistributedRateLimitConfig.description: Optional distributed coordination backend for rate limiters. When present, rate limit state is shared across gateway instances via the configured backend.

backend.description: Distributed backend type. Use valkey for all deployments.

url_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Valkey/Redis-compatible connection URL (required when backend=valkey or redis)

CallbacksSection.description: Array of observability callback sinks. Each proxied request dispatches a CallbackEvent to every configured sink.

CallbackSink.description: A single callback sink configuration. The 'type' field selects the sink implementation; remaining fields are sink-specific.

LangfuseCallbackSink.description: Langfuse observability callback. Sends trace data to a Langfuse instance.

public_key.description: Langfuse public key (literal value). Prefer public_key_env for production.

public_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Langfuse public key.

secret_key.description: Langfuse secret key (literal value). Prefer secret_key_env for production.

secret_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Langfuse secret key.

DatadogCallbackSink.description: Datadog APM callback. Sends metrics and traces to Datadog.

api_key.description: Datadog API key (literal value). Prefer secret_key_ref for production.

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference holding the Datadog API key.

tags.description: Additional Datadog tags attached to every metric/span.

PrometheusCallbackSink.description: Prometheus metrics callback. Exposes request, token, cost, and latency counters on the gateway's /metrics endpoint.

HeliconeCallbackSink.description: Helicone observability callback. Sends request metadata to Helicone.

api_key.description: Helicone API key (literal value). Prefer secret_key_ref for production.

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference holding the Helicone API key.

BraintrustCallbackSink.description: Braintrust eval callback. Sends request data to Braintrust for evaluation.

api_key.description: Braintrust API key (literal value). Prefer secret_key_ref for production.

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference holding the Braintrust API key.

project_name.description: Braintrust project name for this gateway's data.

WebhookCallbackSink.description: Generic webhook callback. POSTs a JSON CallbackEvent to an arbitrary URL with optional HMAC-SHA256 signing.

signing_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for request verification.

signing_secret_env.description: Environment variable name holding the signing secret.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every webhook request.

WebhookEventFilter.description: Controls which events are dispatched to this webhook sink.

types.description: Event types to forward. When empty or omitted, all events are forwarded.

metadata_match.description: Key-value pairs that must all match the event metadata for it to be dispatched.

HealthMonitorConfig.description: Background health monitoring of upstream provider endpoints. Marks providers as unhealthy after consecutive probe failures and optionally alerts via callback URLs.

unhealthy_threshold.description: Number of consecutive probe failures before a provider is marked unhealthy.

alert_callback_urls.description: URLs to POST health-state-change alerts to when a provider transitions between healthy and unhealthy.

HealthMonitorProviderEntry.description: A single provider endpoint to health-check.

name.description: Logical provider name (must match a targets[].id).

AutoProviderConfig.description: Virtual provider that dynamically selects the optimal backend using composite cost and latency scoring.

enabled.description: Whether the auto virtual provider is active.

name.description: Model name clients use to trigger auto-routing (e.g. 'auto').

AutoRoutingConfig.description: Scoring weights and constraints for auto-provider target selection.

cost_weight.description: Weight given to cost factor in composite score (0-1).

latency_weight.description: Weight given to latency factor in composite score (0-1). cost_weight + latency_weight should equal 1.

max_price_per_1m_tokens.description: Maximum price per 1M tokens; providers exceeding this are excluded. When all candidates exceed this ceiling, the router returns no_eligible_provider rather than falling back.

include_disabled.description: When true, include models from disabled provider targets.

ModerationConfig.description: External moderation provider configuration for the /v1/moderations endpoint.

secret_key_ref.description: Environment-backed secret reference containing the API key for the moderation provider.

endpoint.description: Custom moderation endpoint URL (overrides provider default).

threshold.description: Score threshold above which content is flagged.

fail_open.description: When true, history capture failures are logged as warnings and do not block requests.

ReviewRuntimeConfig.description: Runtime review executor settings applied to agent execution.

AgentsRuntimeSection.description: Standalone runtime agent defaults for the gateway.

default_agent_id.description: Default agent UUID applied when the caller does not provide an agent context.

StringArrayOrWildcard.description: Either the wildcard "*" or an explicit non-empty array of non-empty strings.

ContextFabricTtlConfig.description: Retention windows for different context document classes.

ContextFabricConfidenceConfig.description: Confidence thresholds for verification and staleness handling.

ContextFabricCacheConfig.description: Layered-cache settings for the context fabric retrieval path.

ContextFabricMultiGatewayConfig.description: Multi-gateway CRDT replication settings for the context fabric.

ContextFabricConfig.description: Context fabric configuration for a gateway default or a specific agent.

McpSessionLimitsConfig.description: Prompt, cost, and concurrency limits applied to an MCP session.

McpToolServerPolicyConfig.description: Policy controls for durable MCP tool server usage.

McpServerConfig.description: Gateway-level MCP server defaults inherited by agent-scoped MCP sessions.

GatewayAgentDeclaration.description: Agent declaration for agent-scoped context fabric and MCP configuration.

GatewayAgentDeclarationsSection.description: Array of agent declarations for agent-scoped context fabric and MCP configuration.

ToolServerDeclaration.description: Declares a durable MCP tool server for governed execution. Must not be confused with runtime provider bridge targets.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool server within the config.

description.description: Optional description of the tool server's purpose.

mutability_class.description: Declared mutability class. 'unknown' fails closed at runtime.

trust_state.description: Initial trust state. Only 'approved' servers are execution-eligible.

labels.description: Arbitrary key-value labels for ABAC policy binding.

ToolServerTransport.description: Transport configuration for connecting to the tool server.

command.description: Command to spawn for stdio transport.

url.description: Endpoint URL for sse or streamable_http transport.

ToolServerAuth.description: Authentication for the tool server endpoint. Uses secret_key_ref only — no inline secrets.

header_name.description: Custom header name when type is 'header'.

ToolServerContainment.description: Containment constraints for tool server execution.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum execution time per tool call in milliseconds.

SilentEngineConfig.description: Top-level runtime privacy boundary. When enabled, optional telemetry and payload persistence are suppressed while auth, ABAC, expiry, request counters, budget counters, and rate limits remain active.

disable_history.description: Disable history persistence for payload-bearing entries.

disable_gateway_telemetry.description: Disable periodic gateway telemetry reporter pushes.

disable_citation_writeback.description: Disable citation persistence and payload-derived writeback side effects.

minimum_state_mode.description: Controls whether the gateway preserves standard runtime state or only the minimum enforcement state.

AiUsageStreamingConfig.description: Data-plane capture controls for AI Usage SIEM streaming. This stanza owns ONLY enabled, body_capture_max_bytes, and mandatory (fail-closed). Redaction mode and destination selection are API-owned in siem_destinations and must not appear here.

enabled.description: Enable AI usage record capture and forwarding to the API ingestion endpoint.

body_capture_max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to capture for request and response bodies. Content exceeding this limit is truncated with explicit markers and the SHA-256 of the full pre-truncation bytes. Maximum value is 1048576 (1 MiB).

mandatory.description: When true, fail closed (503) if durable enqueue of the AI usage record fails before dispatch. When false, capture failures are logged but do not block the request.
